# PowerShell module Community.Zabbix.Proxy: command reference

One page per command, the same text `Get-Help <command> -Full` shows; `Get-Help <command> -Online` opens the page. Concepts are in `Get-Help about_Community.Zabbix`.

| Command | Synopsis |
| --- | --- |
| [Set-ZbxActiveProxy](Set-ZbxActiveProxy.md) | Changes how often a running active proxy session pulls its configuration. |
| [Start-ZbxActiveProxy](Start-ZbxActiveProxy.md) | Starts an active proxy's uplink as a session: it re-pulls the server's configuration on a cadence, until stopped. |
| [Stop-ZbxActiveProxy](Stop-ZbxActiveProxy.md) | Stops an active proxy session. |
| [Register-ZbxActiveProxyDataProvider](Register-ZbxActiveProxyDataProvider.md) | Registers a scriptblock that supplies values for each upload of a running active proxy session. |
| [Clear-ZbxActiveProxyLog](Clear-ZbxActiveProxyLog.md) | Empties the log buffer of a running active proxy session. |
| [Get-ZbxActiveProxyLog](Get-ZbxActiveProxyLog.md) | Gets the recent log entries of a running active proxy session. |
| [Get-ZbxActiveProxyStatus](Get-ZbxActiveProxyStatus.md) | Gets the running active proxy sessions. |
| [Register-ZbxActiveProxyTaskHandler](Register-ZbxActiveProxyTaskHandler.md) | Registers a scriptblock that runs the tasks the server gives a running active proxy session. |
| [Read-ZbxConnectorStream](Read-ZbxConnectorStream.md) | Reads the newline-delimited JSON a Zabbix connector sends and hands each record on. |
| [New-ZbxHistoryDataEntry](New-ZbxHistoryDataEntry.md) | Builds one history value entry, for use with New-ZbxProxyData -History or Send-ZbxProxyData. |
| [New-ZbxHistoryValue](New-ZbxHistoryValue.md) | Builds one value for the history data of a proxy data request. |
| [Start-ZbxPassiveProxy](Start-ZbxPassiveProxy.md) | Starts a passive proxy's listener as a session: the server pushes configuration and pulls history until stopped. |
| [Stop-ZbxPassiveProxy](Stop-ZbxPassiveProxy.md) | Stops a passive proxy session. |
| [Register-ZbxPassiveProxyConfigHandler](Register-ZbxPassiveProxyConfigHandler.md) | Registers a scriptblock that checks every configuration the server pushes to a passive proxy session. |
| [Register-ZbxPassiveProxyDataProvider](Register-ZbxPassiveProxyDataProvider.md) | Registers a scriptblock that supplies values each time the server pulls a passive proxy session's data. |
| [Send-ZbxPassiveProxyHistory](Send-ZbxPassiveProxyHistory.md) | Queues a value in a running passive proxy session, for the server to pull. |
| [Clear-ZbxPassiveProxyLog](Clear-ZbxPassiveProxyLog.md) | Empties the log buffer of a running passive proxy session. |
| [Get-ZbxPassiveProxyLog](Get-ZbxPassiveProxyLog.md) | Gets the recent log entries of a running passive proxy session. |
| [Register-ZbxPassiveProxyStatsProvider](Register-ZbxPassiveProxyStatsProvider.md) | Registers a scriptblock that answers zabbix.stats requests to a passive proxy session. |
| [Get-ZbxPassiveProxyStatus](Get-ZbxPassiveProxyStatus.md) | Gets the running passive proxy sessions. |
| [Receive-ZbxProxyConfig](Receive-ZbxProxyConfig.md) | Pulls an active proxy's configuration once, with no session. |
| [New-ZbxProxyData](New-ZbxProxyData.md) | Builds a proxy data request without sending it. |
| [Send-ZbxProxyData](Send-ZbxProxyData.md) | Sends one page of history values as an active proxy. |
